verdict.rationale: Alma shows a visa-fit output that rates O-1A as "Recommended" and EB-1A as "Strong". It also documents a pre-filing intake through portal questionnaires and an attorney strategy meeting, and says it flags risk early. That points to its own qualification assessment, but nothing documents how evidence is scored against the specific USCIS O-1A criteria. missing for 10: documented criterion-by-criterion evaluation methodology against the USCIS O-1A criteria, a sample or description of the written assessment deliverable, O-1A-specific confirmation of the pre-filing intake (the questionnaire/strategy-meeting evidence is from the H-1B page), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get a structured O-1A qualification assessment — the provider documents how it evaluates my extraordinary-ability evidence against the USCIS criteria before anything is filed
